mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ITINERARY ( user_id, title, summary, continent, country, city, traveler_count, start_date, end_date, total_budget, visibility, thumbnail_img, source_itinerary_id ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{continent}, #{country}, #{city}, #{travelerCount}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{totalBudget}, #{visibility}, #{thumbnailImg}, #{sourceItineraryId} )
mapper.select: SELECT itinerary_id, user_id, title, summary, continent, country, city, traveler_count, start_date, end_date, total_budget, visibility, thumbnail_img, view_count, source_itinerary_id, status, deleted_by_user_id, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM TB_ITINERARY WHERE itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ITINERARY SET title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, continent = #{continent}, country = #{country}, city = #{city}, traveler_count = #{travelerCount}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, total_budget = #{totalBudget}, visibility = #{visibility}, thumbnail_img = #{thumbnailImg}, source_itinerary_id = #{sourceItineraryId} WHERE itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE TB_ITINERARY SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_by_user_id = #{userId}, deleted_at = NOW() WHERE itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
